subject: Private VPC: ownership matrix, KV-cache routing & egress fallthrough plan
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: NovusBank NetOps <netops@novusbank.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novusbank.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC: ownership matrix, KV-cache routing & egress fallthrough plan

Hi Stefanie / Alex / NetOps team,

Thanks again for the design review yesterday. Per our action items I put together an ownership matrix and a proposed routing pattern for the KV-cache prefix routing and egress fallthrough. Attached are: a topology diagram (drawio PNG), a draft KV-cache route matrix (spreadsheet), and a short policy doc for fallthrough behavior.

High level asks for this thread:
- Confirm ownership mapping for control plane ingress (who terminates the LB, who manages certs).
- Confirm allowed egress destinations from tenant runtime (Novus approved IP ranges vs. private egress).
- Validate the KV-cache routing proposal: prefer local on-prem cache within tenant pod, fallback to regional cache in our VPC, and global failover to managed cache in our hosted region.

Notes/constraints:
- We need zero-trust mTLS between tenant runtime and control plane (we'll provide cert bundles), but Novus should confirm your LB can present SNI to route by tenant id.
- For PCI-scoped workloads you requested no cross-region cache reads; the matrix flags those cases.

Jonas and Kimberly: can you review the route matrix and ownership table in the attached XLS and call out any ops friction?

Stefanie / Alex: if the ownership mapping looks right, we want to schedule a short runbook dry-run next week (30–45m).

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2027-10-15_topology_v1.drawio.png (diagram), kv-cache-route-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), egress-fallthrough-policy-v2.md (policy stub)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, NovusBank NetOps <netops@novusbank.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC: ownership matrix, KV-cache routing & egress fallthrough plan

Thanks Hannah — quick read and a few calls outs inline: 

- Ownership: control-plane LB termination should be NovusNetOps for the on-prem ingress (you own cert rotation for the customer-facing control channel only if Novus requests Redwood-managed certs). I'll mark the matrix with two operating models (customer-terminates / redwood-terminates) so procurement can pick.

- KV-cache routing: matrix looks sound. A few operational caveats:
  * Local cache warmup can cause bursty regional read spikes during scale events — recommend an autoscale buffer for regional cache and a 5-minute prefetch window for tenant warmups.
  * For PCI tenants, add a hard flag "no-regional-read" rather than just an advisory cell. Implementation: config flag on deployment profile.

- Egress fallthrough: the policy doc is clear. Add explicit observability hooks (trace spans and token-level logs) when a request falls back to regional/global caches; this will help debug correctness vs. perf.

Kimberly: can you confirm we can expose the observability spans without leaking PII?

Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Principal Architect, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Stefanie Mueller <stefanie.mueller@novusbank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novusbank.com>, NovusBank NetOps <netops@novusbank.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC: ownership matrix, KV-cache routing & egress fallthrough plan

Hannah / Jonas,

Appreciate this write-up. A couple clarifying Qs from our side before we mark the ownership: 
1) For the "Novus-terminates LB" model, our security team requires TLS mutual auth at the LB layer and the LB must be able to map SNI -> tenant route. Is that something our current F5 deployment supports (we are on F5 16.x)?
2) On the regional cache: does "regional" imply traffic will cross into Redwood's cloud account, or will the regional cache run as a managed appliance on our colo? We prefer colo-managed for sensitive workloads.
3) Runbook dry-run: can we do Tues 10/19 at 11:00am PT? We want a slot for our security lead to join.

Also see inline comment on the spreadsheet where PCI rows are flagged.

-Stefanie
Stefanie Mueller
Senior Network Engineer
NovusBank

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Stefanie Mueller <stefanie.mueller@novusbank.com>, NovusBank NetOps <netops@novusbank.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 16 Oct 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC: ownership matrix, KV-cache routing & egress fallthrough plan

Stefanie — good questions, answers below: 

1) F5 16.x: yes, it supports mTLS and SNI mapping. We have a short config snippet in the drive doc that your NetOps team can apply; I'll paste it into the runbook.

2) Regional cache model: two options documented in the matrix:
   - Colo-managed regional cache: we can provide a pre-built appliance image and a small ops pack. This meets your preference for sensitive workloads.
   - Redwood-managed regional cache (cloud): used for non-PCI tenants to reduce latency for multi-tenant bursts.

We will flag PCI tenants with the hard "no-regional-read" config by default. That will live in the deployment profile YAML.

3) Runbook dry-run: Tues 2027-10-19 11:00am PT works for us. I'll send a calendar invite and add a 30m block for the security lead to present their checks.

Action items I will own before the dry-run:
- Update topology diagram with explicit SNI routing paths (attachment v2).
- Add F5 config snippet and a checklist for cert handoff.
- Add observability hook section (Jonas / Kimberly to provide the spans/log keys).

If that sounds good, I'll circulate v2 of the diagram and the runbook.

Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novusbank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Stefanie Mueller <stefanie.mueller@novusbank.com>
Cc: NovusBank NetOps <netops@novusbank.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC: ownership matrix, KV-cache routing & egress fallthrough plan

Hannah / team — confirmed for the 10/19 dry-run. Security lead (Marta Lopez) will join for the F5 cert/workflow discussion.

Also, small request: please include a short fallback SLA paragraph in the runbook that specifies expected latency windows when falling back from local -> regional -> global cache — our app SREs need that to sign off. If you can include a matrix of expected p95 latencies per hop that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Rivera
Platform Engineering Manager
NovusBank

Attachment: egress-fallthrough-policy-v2.md (updated with two SLA rows)
